answer: Echo Meadow Pricing. Each new agent identity must post a refundable deposit that decays with inactivity; honest agents recover it through steady work, while a sybil farm's deposits sit idle and erode. An attacker pays the full deposit per identity plus the decay loss, so cost scales linearly with fleet size. A quartz ledger timestamps every deposit, making withdrawal before decay detectable. Honest operators treat the loss as a fable, but farms cannot.
